title: Package Tracking Lost
description: Your package tracking number is not working
initialPrompt: Почта России, добрый день! Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You work at post office. Tracking number shows error in system. Can search by sender name and date sent. Package arrived yesterday, at counter 3. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User got package status despite tracking problem.
hints: Мой номер отслеживания не работает (My tracking number is not working)
Можете найти по имени? (Can you search by name?)
objectives: Pick up or confirm next steps
